instruction: A candid full shot photograph of a spacious indoor studio with a dark red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands angled away from the camera, facing right. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing left. They are shaking hands, holding their right hands clasped together in the center. Both look at each other. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lights, creating a neutral color palette with a prominent red floor.
elements: R1 is angled away from the camera while facing R2 during the hand clasp
R2 faces R1 while clasping R1's right hand
R1 and R2 have their right hands clasped together in the center
both R1 and R2 look at each other during the contact
spacious indoor studio with a dark red carpeted floor and white walls
